name: Barbarian
skillChoices: Choose 2: Animal Handling, Athletics, Intimidation, Nature, Perception, or Survival
startingEquipment: (a) Greataxe, 4 Handaxes, Explorer's Pack, and 15 GP or (b) 75 GP
multiclass: Prerequisite: Strength 13. Proficiencies gained: Shields, Martial Weapons.

name: Bard
skillChoices: Choose any 3 skills; Three musical instruments of your choice
startingEquipment: (a) Leather Armor, 2 Daggers, Musical Instrument of your choice, Entertainer’s Pack, and 19 GP; or (b) 90 GP
multiclass: Prerequisite: Charisma 13. Proficiencies gained: Light Armor, 1 skill, 1 musical instrument.

name: Cleric
skillChoices: Choose 2: History, Insight, Medicine, Persuasion, or Religion
startingEquipment: (a) Chain Shirt, Shield, Mace, Holy Symbol, Priest's Pack, and 7 GP; or (b) 110 GP
multiclass: Prerequisite: Wisdom 13. Proficiencies gained: Light Armor, Medium Armor, Shields.

name: Druid
skillChoices: Choose 2: Arcana, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Religion, or Survival
startingEquipment: (a) Leather Armor, Shield, Sickle, Druidic Focus (Quarterstaff), Explorer's Pack, Herbalism Kit, and 9 GP; or (a) 50 GP
multiclass: Prerequisite: Wisdom 13. Proficiencies gained: Light Armor, Shields.

name: Fighter
skillChoices: Choose 2: Acrobatics, Animal Handling, Athletics, History, Insight, Intimidation, Perception, or Survival
startingEquipment: (a) Chain Mail, Greatsword, Flail, 8 Javelins, Dungeoneer’s Pack, and 4 GP; (b) Studded Leather Armor, Scimitar, Shortsword, Longbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Dungeoneer’s Pack, and 11 GP; or (c) 155 GP
multiclass: Prerequisite: Strength 13 or Dexterity 13. Proficiencies gained: Light Armor, Medium Armor, Shields, Martial Weapons.

name: Monk
skillChoices: Choose 2: Acrobatics, Athletics, History, Insight, Religion, or Stealth; Choose one type of artisan’s tools or one musical instrument
startingEquipment: (a) Spear, 5 Daggers, Artisan’s Tools or Musical Instrument chosen for the tool proficiency above, Explorer’s Pack, and 11 GP; or (b) 50 GP

name: Paladin
skillChoices: Choose 2: Athletics, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Persuasion, or Religion
startingEquipment: (a) Chain Mail, Shield, Longsword, 6 Javelins, Holy Symbol, Priest’s Pack, and 9 GP; or (b) 150 GP
multiclass: Prerequisite: Strength 13 and Charisma 13. Proficiencies gained: Light Armor, Medium Armor, Shields, Martial Weapons.

name: Ranger
skillChoices: Choose 3: Animal Handling, Athletics, Insight, Investigation, Nature, Perception, Stealth, or Survival
startingEquipment: (a) Studded Leather Armor, Scimitar, Shortsword, Longbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Druidic Focus (sprig of mistletoe), Explorer's Pack, and 7 GP; or (b) 150 GP
multiclass: Prerequisite: Dexterity 13 and Wisdom 13. Proficiencies gained: Light Armor, Medium Armor, Shields, Martial Weapons, 1 undefined.

name: Rogue
skillChoices: Choose 4: Acrobatics, Athletics, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Perception, Performance, Persuasion, Sleight of Hand, or Stealth
startingEquipment: (a) Leather Armor, 2 Daggers, Shortsword, Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Thieves’ Tools, Burglar’s Pack, and 8 GP; (b) 100 GP
multiclass: Prerequisite: Dexterity 13. Proficiencies gained: Light Armor, Tool: Thieves' Tools, 1 undefined.

name: Sorcerer
skillChoices: Choose 2: Arcana, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion, or Religion
startingEquipment: (a) Spear, 2 Daggers, Arcane Focus (crystal), Dungeoneer’s Pack, and 28 GP; or (b) 50 GP

name: Warlock
skillChoices: Choose 2: from Arcana, Deception, History, Intimidation, Investigation, Nature, or Religion
startingEquipment: (a) Leather Armor, Sickle, 2 Daggers, Arcane Focus (orb), Book, Scholar’s Pack, and 15 GP; or (b) 100 GP
multiclass: Prerequisite: Charisma 13. Proficiencies gained: Light Armor.

name: Wizard
skillChoices: Choose 2: Arcana, History, Insight, Investigation, Medicine, or Religion
startingEquipment: (a) 2 Daggers, Arcane Focus (Quarterstaff), Robe, Spellbook, Scholar’s Pack, and 5 GP; or (b) 55 GP
